These are estimates from general knowledge of NAS-Bench-201 structure, with no benchmark data queried. They rest on a few heuristics:

- Removing or weakening an edge matters less when a parallel or alternative path already carries information.
- Edit effects on conv ops are larger when the competing paths are weak.
- Interactions that hold consistently across all three datasets by a meaningful margin are rare, so most claims get low-to-moderate probabilities.
